units.source_text: 这件事说好之后的第二个晚上，丸佐老板从横滨回来了，专门来我家拜访。

en.t: On the second evening after this matter had been settled, the owner of Marusa came back from Yokohama and made a special visit to my house.

units.source_text: 我家在遭遇第三次火灾之后，就没有重新修建。

en.t: After our house suffered its third fire, it was never rebuilt.

units.source_text: 全家人都住在没被大火烧毁的仓库里，并且往外面搭建出一个店铺来。

en.t: The whole family lived in the storehouse that had escaped the great fire, and we added a shop onto the outside.

units.source_text: 本来就是仓促开的药铺，所以只有一个金属招牌，上面写着正德丸、调经丸、去胎毒散等药名，以及一座药柜。

en.t: Since it was a hastily opened pharmacy to begin with, all it had was a metal signboard with names of medicines such as Shotokugan, Chokeigan, and Ketai-dokusan written on it, along with a medicine cabinet.
Oh yes, there was also an endless lamp.

units.source_text: 可能大家不知道这是什么灯。

en.t: You may not know what kind of lamp that was.

units.source_text: 其实不过是一种用油菜籽代替煤油的老式油灯。

en.t: In fact, it was nothing more than an old-fashioned oil lamp that used rapeseed oil instead of kerosene.

units.source_text: 说起来很有意思，到如今，我只要闻到诸如陈皮、大黄等药材的气味，就会不由自主的想起无尽灯。

en.t: Strangely enough, even now, whenever I smell medicinal ingredients like dried tangerine peel or rhubarb, I cannot help thinking of that endless lamp.

units.source_text: 没错，那天晚上，无尽灯将整个屋子笼罩在昏暗的灯光下，屋里还飘散着药材的气味。

en.t: Yes, that evening, the endless lamp bathed the whole room in dim light, and the smell of medicinal herbs still drifted through the room.
